title: Rules-based strategies: trend following and channel breakouts
summary: Two families of rules-based strategies, taught as simplified educational versions: moving-average trend following and channel breakouts. Practised in Chart Lab and Replay on simulated charts. Named historical versions of these systems are added to TradeLab only after a person has checked them against reliable sources.
practicalResult: Apply the moving-average and channel-breakout rules in Replay on simulated charts, with entry, exit, stop and size written down before each trade.
